task: Audit existing GEE comparisons and build a browser viewer over static HTTP object storage
gee_audit: Report only existing evidence; no new live GEE requests or exports.
Distinguish full feature/attribute parity, sampled diagnostics, failed strict checks, source fidelity, and untested counterparts.
Bind conclusions to the currently selected release and exact evidence paths/hashes.
viewer: Five prepared products must display real release data; LakeATLAS polygons and pour points remain separate layers.
Browser reads PMTiles and GeoParquet directly over HTTP byte ranges; no server-side feature or SQL query endpoint.
Use separate loopback UI and object origins to exercise CORS; support GET/HEAD/OPTIONS and correct 206/416 range semantics.
Object URLs mirror the proposed nthh/product/releases layout; only explicit plan files may be served. No directory listing, credentials, arbitrary path access, mutation, upload, or publication.
GDW and SWOT are visibly unavailable, with actual blockers rather than mock data.
Include pan/zoom, dataset/layer selection, feature properties, edition/validation notes, loading/empty/error states, and byte-transfer information.
At least one browser view per ready product and both LakeATLAS layers must show nonzero features with successful range responses; use fixed geographic controls.

Fresh-context tests must demonstrate partial reads for each large analytical file, with a 128 MiB per-layer evaluation transfer ceiling; no whole-dataset download. Preserve failures and precommit any revised diagnostic.
Focused range/security/client tests and clean-checkout generation must pass.
cost_scope: Reuse existing packages; small pinned browser dependencies permitted. No bulk source downloads, GEE jobs, remote writes or new data conversions.

design_intent.human: Nathan reviewing retained hydrology releases before Source Cooperative publication
design_intent.action: Browse each real release, inspect a feature and see whether remote-style partial reads work
design_intent.feel: A compact map workbench with quiet controls and clear data provenance
design_intent.signature: Each selected layer connects its map, exact release URL, GEE check status and bytes fetched
defaults_replaced: Metric-card dashboard replaced with a map and compact dataset rail
Decorative basemap replaced with subdued geographic context
Global loading spinner replaced with per-layer loading and transfer state
design_intent.palette: Paper/gray surfaces, river-blue selection and data; amber reserved for unavailable/incomplete states
design_intent.depth: Fine borders and surface shifts; no decorative shadows
design_intent.typography: System sans-serif for labels, tabular/monospace for bytes, IDs and coordinates
